provider: Azure for Students (and Azure for Students Starter)

free_tier.stated: $100 credit per 12 months plus free monthly amounts of 20+ services; no credit card required. Explicitly renewable: 'Renew your subscription annually and continue to get free access to Azure as long as you're a student.' Starter tier (13-17) gives services without the $100.

egress.terms: The 100 GB/month free internet egress (all Azure customers) applies; beyond that metered.

tooling: Azure Blob REST / rclone azureblob / azcopy, same as paid Azure.
chaining: $100/year at ~$0.0184/GB-month hot LRS ≈ 5.4 TB-months per year ≈ 450 GB held for the full year, and it renews yearly while student status holds. It is the only yearly-renewable big-cloud credit found.
limits_note: Student verification required; $100 is annual, not monthly; the 12-month free service amounts (including 5 GB blob) are separate and 'new Azure customers only'.

identity_cost.detail: sign-up uses a school email address

reliability_note: Subscription is disabled at year end until renewed; data can be lost if the subscription lapses and is later reactivated.

evidence.proved: '$100 credit to use on Azure services within 12 months'; 'Renew your subscription annually and continue to get free access to Azure as long as you're a student'
